$comment: Generated from AttemptDone in src/contract/attempt.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. A runner's message when the eval's body has finished, with what it threw.
title: AttemptDone

AttemptDone.description: The runner to reeval: the eval's body has finished. The attempt's graders and record follow.

error.description: What the body threw, if it threw.

turnStatusRead.description: True when the body read turn.status. False when a turn errored and status was never read.

AttemptThrown.description: What an eval's body threw: an `EvalError` (`name` `EvalError`, its reason as `message`, and its meta) or any other error.

meta.description: An `EvalError`'s meta: a JSON object recorded beside its reason.

stack.description: The error's traceback, in the runner's own format.
